description: Certificate of Lawfulness (Proposed) is sought for construction of a loft extension to the existing dwellinghouse, works include formation of a rear dormer extension, installation of new windows within the dormer, installation of rooflights, internal works to form one bedroom and one bathroom and structural alterations to support new loft floor and dormer structure.The proposal involves the construction of a loft extension to the existing dwellinghouse. The works include: Formation of a rear dormer extension to create additional habitable space. Installation of new windows within the dormer. Installation of rooflights to the front roof slope. Internal works to form one bedroom and one bathroom within the converted loft space. Associated structural alterations required to support the new loft floor and dormer structure (steel beam). No new access, new streets, or hard-standings are proposed as part of this application.
